stage: prospective integration and feasibility pilot, written before new training outcomes
meeting_interpretation: Use one small common lucidrains backbone and evaluation contract for sleep and Hebbian development. Defer reproducing every paper architecture. Speaker assignments and changed deadlines are unverified in the noisy transcript.
purpose: Produce a reloadable complete sequence-model checkpoint and check whether its neural memory contributes useful context, separately from the earlier symbolic Reader mechanism experiments.

model.implementation: vendored lucidrains MemoryAsContextTransformer, unmodified; not claimed paper-faithful MAC
model.implementation_choices: Segmented attention; no accelerated scan/flex attention, weight residual, different layer views, lookahead values or spectral normalization. Exact resolved defaults are saved with each run.

data.source: Existing repository data/enwik8.gz; full content hash recorded at load
data.sampling: Training start offsets sampled with replacement within train only. Dev:128 distinct nonoverlapping 1025-byte blocks on a seeded grid; 256-byte evaluation uses identical prefixes.
data.test_policy: Reserved test region is not evaluated in this pilot. The dev region is development data, not an untouched final test.

training.schedule: constant learning rate; no checkpoint selection by dev scores
training.selection: Fixed final checkpoint; seed68101 is the primary candidate,68105 is a sensitivity run. Preserve all seeds/failures. No selecting the best of two.
training.fast_state: Reset between independent windows, updated causally within each window; outer training differentiates through the implementation's memory updates. No cross-session carry claim.

evaluation.metrics: Per-window next-byte NLL sums and bytes, mean NLL, bits per byte; late positions256..1023 separately at length1024.
evaluation.initial: Normal condition at length256 before training; same fixed development windows.
evaluation.controls: Zero read output is an inference ablation, not a separately trained attention baseline. Segment-reset keeps within-segment memory computation but removes memory from previous segments. Both preserve outer weights.
evaluation.uncertainty: 5000 paired window bootstrap draws, seed68104, conditional on each fixed checkpoint and sampled corpus blocks; not training-seed or corpus-level uncertainty.
evaluation.acceptance: Complete finite fixed training budget, causal suffix checks, finite memory gradients, exact checkpoint reload predictions, dev256 NLL improvement>=0.2nats/byte. Memory-context usefulness additionally requires lower normal NLL than segment-reset on late long-window positions with positive paired95% lower bound for reset-minus-normal.
evaluation.interpretation: Falling language loss alone does not establish memory usefulness, factual retention, sleep benefits, or a fair comparison to a separately adapted Hebbian model. Do not scale if validity checks fail.

separate_followup.protocol: Run the unchanged previously recorded decay-diagnostic-design.json from November13 on checkpoint48103 using exact original development-stream prefixes and source commitd93ac37. This cannot change the original failed two-seed criterion.

resources.maximum: one newly requested GPU allocation for at most one hour; release promptly after jobs; do not renew automatically
resources.stop: Preserve failures on nonfinite values, invalid causality or split/checkpoint invariants, allocation expiry, or per-run deadline. A tiny smoke run checks feasibility before the fixed pilots.
